name: /today command — daily operator morning cockpit
block: Phase 1 — TikTok gate (0/30 posts, ~22 days to Apr 7)
goal: Add /today Telegram command (owner-only). Single morning dashboard: shows today's posting target (posts/day needed to hit gate), the #1 next video to post (top unposted from publish-ledger.jsonl), and top 3 viral topics from viral-topics.json. Compact single message. Complements /pace (which drills into pace math) and /queue (full list) — /today is the quick morning start command.
rationale: Operator needs one command to start the posting day: 'what do I post today and how many?' Right now they need /pace + /queue + manual lookup of viral-topics.json. /today collapses it into one tap. Drives daily posting habit which is critical to hit 30-post gate by Apr 7.
